name: RSS Keyword Alert to Telegram
description: Polls RSS feeds and sends a Telegram alert only when an entry matches a keyword you choose, with duplicate-entry protection.

setupVars.label: telegram chat id (was the n8n environment variable TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID)

setup: Setup value telegramChatId: telegram chat id (was the n8n environment variable TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID). Write it into the Workflow Configs initialContext before import.
Setup value api: Api. Write it into the Workflow Configs initialContext before import.
Setup value inserisciChatId: Inserisci Chat Id. Write it into the Workflow Configs initialContext before import.
After import, start the schedule: cdecli cron activate rss-keyword-alert-to-telegram.

hints: Select the Project and Environment on the Workflow Configs node (the ids from `cdecli auth status`), then connect a credential for each connector below.
Connect telegram: `cdecli credential create -n "telegram" -p telegram --template <formId> --secret <key>=<value>` (see `cdecli credential templates`).
